name: Layout Responsiveness — elements render cleanly across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports
description: Verifies that core typography, motorcycle stages, navigation bars, and forms adapt responsively without horizontal page overflow.

planSteps.description: Navigate to / and inspect desktop layout at standard screen width
The desktop navigation links and full-size hero typography fit without horizontal scrollbar on the page root
Scroll down through the 3D Experience, Parts Archive, Collection, and Contact sections
All major section headings ('THE MACHINE, UP CLOSE.', 'ANATOMY OF A LEGEND', 'CHOOSE YOUR RIDE.', 'START YOUR JOURNEY.') render legibly
Interactive elements, buttons, and form inputs maintain accessible tap/click targets and proportional padding across viewport widths
